source.title: Next Week on XBOX: New Games for November 9 to 13
source.evidenceText: Will Fulton, XBOX Wire Editor November 6, 2026 · 13 min read Welcome to Next Week on XBOX! In this weekly feature we cover all the games coming soon to XBOX Series X|S, XBOX One, XBOX on PC, and Game Pass! Get more details on these upcoming games below and click their profiles for further info (release dates subject to change). Let’s jump in! Football Manager 27 SEGA ☆☆☆☆☆ ★★★★★ Get it now PC Game Pass Football Manager 27 – November 10Game Pass Choose the club. Shape the squad. Set the tactics. Chase the future only you can see. FM27 is where your footballing beliefs become a reality. Make The Call. Pick the team. Define your style. Spot what other managers might miss. Maybe you take a chance on the academy prospect. Maybe you sell the star who just doesn’t get your vision. Train your team to work as one. Build a tactical blueprint that’s unmistakably yours. Then lead your team out to admiration from the stands as you take your place on the touchline. Football Manager 27 Console SEGA ☆☆☆☆☆ 52 ★★★★★ $59.99 Get it now PC Game Pass Xbox Game Pass Football Manager 27 Console – November 10Game Pass / XBOX Play Anywhere Choose the club. Shape the squad. Set the tactics. Chase the future only you can see. FM27 Console is where your footballing beliefs become a reality. Make The Call. Immerse yourself in the managerial journey with refined layouts that give you a clearer view of what matters most to sharpen your approach. Smarter navigation makes use of every inch of space, while fully customisable Controller Mapping puts more power in your hands, so you can tailor your setup to your gameplan. TANUKI: Pon's Summer CRITICAL REFLEX ☆☆☆☆☆ 64 ★★★★★ $19.99 Get it now PC Game Pass Xbox Game Pass TANUKI: Pon’s Summer – November 10Game Pass / Smart Delivery / XBOX Play Anywhere Hop on your BMX and deliver letters and packages to the quirky inhabitants of TANUKI’s fictional Japanese island. Packages vary in size, weight, and shape so it’ll be up to you to strategise how you approach each delivery. As you build up friendship and loyalty with the inhabitants, they’ll ask for help with a range of different activities. Take part to unlock items and rewards that will help with the shrine’s restoration. Warhammer Survivors Auroch Digital ☆☆☆☆☆ 384 ★★★★★ $7.99 Get it now PC Game Pass Xbox Game Pass Warhammer Survivors – November 10Game Pass / XBOX Play Anywhere Warhammer Survivors is a fast-paced roguelite survivors’ game, pitting a host of iconic Warhammer characters against endless hordes of enemies from multiple Warhammer factions. Developed by Auroch Digital (Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun) in partnership with Warhammer and poncle (Vampire Survivors), discover the universes of Warhammer 40,000 and Warhammer: Age of Sigmar in all its pixel glory in this new surviv-a-ton. Hope in the City Lofty Sky Games and NAGA Games ☆☆☆☆☆ 169 ★★★★★ $19.99 Get it now PC Game Pass Xbox Game Pass Hope in the City – November 11Game Pass / XBOX Play Anywhere Your sketches may be the only clues you have. Play as 17-year-old Hope Song in this narrative mystery set in Shenyang, China. While everyone around her cracks under exam pressure, Hope escapes into her drawings, until her parents disappear. Investigate what happened, connect the clues, and uncover the truth hidden beneath the city’s calm. 9 Kings Hooded Horse ☆☆☆☆☆ 6 ★★★★★ Get it now PC Game Pass 9 Kings (Game Preview) – November 12Game Pass Build your city into the most powerful of all kingdoms through endless combinations of buildings, units, spells, and positioning. Take advantage of chaotic combos and powerful perks to break the game and become overpowered. Grow your kingdom in strategic ways, prepare for dozens of unique events, and show the world your kingdom can outlast all others in both single and async multiplayer. This game is a work in progress. It may or may not change over time or release as a final product. Purchase only if you are comfortable with the current state of the unfinished game. Hozy tinyBuild ☆☆☆☆☆ 7 ★★★★★ $14.99 $11.99 Get it now Hozy – November 9XBOX Play Anywhere Wrap yourself in a cozy atmosphere where every small action and detail matters. Hozy is about slowing down. There are no timers, scores, penalties, and absolutely no stress or pressure. Just you, your tools, and the simple joy of making spaces beautiful again. Whether you’re wiping windows, repainting walls, or finding the perfect spot for a sofa, everything is designed to keep you in a calm, satisfying flow. Captain Coco: Treasure Island (Xbox Series) Afil Games ☆☆☆☆☆ 1 ★★★★★ $4.99 Get it now Captain Coco: Treasure Island – November 10 Set sail for a tropical puzzle adventure in Captain Coco: Treasure Island! Join Captain Coco, a clever pirate monkey on a mission to crack open treasure chests by pushing coconuts across mysterious island levels. But don’t be fooled by the sunny beaches and lush jungles! Every stage is a brain-teasing challenge that requires careful planning, clever moves, and a little pirate ingenuity. Hard West 2 Klabater ☆☆☆☆☆ 4 ★★★★★ $34.99 Get it now Hard West 2 – November 10 Hard West 2 is a journey to the heart of darkness in the American West. Take control of a supernatural posse and catch the mysterious Ghost Train. Outsmart, outcheat and outgun your enemies in this turn-based tactics game set in a Wild West world where nothing is as it seems. Ova Magica Top Hat Studios, Inc. ☆☆☆☆☆ 8 ★★★★★ $29.99 $23.99 Get it now Ova Magica – November 10Smart Delivery Start a new life on an overgrown farm in the rural and peaceful Clover Town. You’re not alone this time—raise adorable blob companions that help you farm, explore, and make new friends. Ova Magica blends farm-life simulation with creature-collecting JRPG gameplay for a cozy yet adventurous experience. source.title: Introducing Hounded: Crafting the dog adventure coming to PS5 in 2027
source.evidenceText: November 17, 2026November 17, 2026 Introducing Hounded: Crafting the dog adventure coming to PS5 in 2027 13 0 93 Like this Imprnt Studios founders share insights on how to craft the perfect dog protagonist. Julia Galus Marketing Specialist, Silver Lining Interactive Hey PlayStation community! We’ve been keeping a secret under wraps at Imprnt Studios and Silver Lining Interactive, and we can finally let the dog out of the bag: Hounded is heading to PS5 in 2027. Get ready to step into the paws of a brave (and incredibly adorable) Border Collie, Duke, as you help him search for his lost master in an epic journey across the conflict-torn world of Anglodia. Hounded has been in development for just over two years, and in that time we’ve been hard at work developing our very own Motion Matching system for our main character. Along with this exciting announcement, we wanted to show you what making our passion project actually looks like behind the scenes. So, we put together our very first dev diary with a full look into how the sausage (or kibble?) gets made. Have you ever wondered how you make a dog communicate through animation? Or what a realistic quadruped animation made from scratch looks like before it lands on your screen? We’re tackling all of that and more, while introducing the little guy who started this entire journey: Duke. Check it out. Play Video A dog story – who is Duke? Duke is a young, clumsy, yet loyal Border Collie. He lives in the world of Anglodia – a flintlock fantasy inspired Britain in the late 18th century. It is a beautiful and mythical land filled with mysterious technology that is coming apart at the seams under tyrannical rule. However, Duke’s interests lie outside of politics and the brewing rebellion against the crown… His master, Artemys Fletcher – a secretive key player in the resistance, has vanished. Duke’s home has been torn apart by the regime and the only thing that matters now is finding his master. Building a border collie from the paws up Here’s the thing about four-legged protagonists: you can’t just reskin a two-legged skeleton and call it a day. In our earliest test builds, Duke moved like a clunky wooden table with paws. It felt terrible—Border Collies have this iconic, low-slung energy that looks like they are about to run at all times. To bring this into reality in Unreal Engine, we decided to animate all of Duke’s movement by hand, using a handcrafted Motion Matching system. Eventually, we were able to set it up so that it pulls from a library of animations based on real-world references, selects the most appropriate animation for the movement, and smooths out the whole process (for the dev team and for the players). What does the dog say? Giving Duke a good expressive range has easily been one of the biggest creative mountains our narrative and animation teams had to climb. While humans rely on words, smirks, and raised eyebrows, Duke has muzzle twitches, ear pivots, and whiskers. We spent a while studying canine expressions and famous animated dogs (shout out to Dug) to make sure Duke could hold his own in cinematic story moments. Every movement, every sad face, and every happy snout you will see in the game is handcrafted by our incredible animation team. More than just a good boy – Magic of The Tide As adorable as he looks, Duke is far from an ordinary dog. Beneath the soil of Anglodia hums an ancient, strange magic known as The Tide, and Duke is one of its wielders. He possesses unlockable abilities that no other hound has, such as the Power Bark (smash through obstacles in your way) and Power Howl (electrically charge the mysterious technology you find in the world). He can even pierce the veil to perceive ghostly echoes trapped in time, known as Imprints, reliving moments that unfolded hours before he arrived. What will he discover, and will it help him find Fletcher? Wishlist on PS5 today Seeing our game come to life on PlayStation 5 is a dream come true for the whole team—you can add it to your wishlist on your console today. We’ve still got miles to run before 2027, but we wanted to put Duke on your radar early. Take the dev diary for a walk, tell us what you think of Duke, and give your own pets a solid scratch behind the ears from everyone on the crew today. HoundedImprnt Studios Did you like this?
